title: Unfinalized Stub placeholder blocks in executable files
description: Placeholder Outline/Problems/ToDo stubs are repeatedly left in active scripts/modules, signaling unfinished documentation and noisy quality scans.
detection_method: Regex scan for known stub placeholder phrases appended to active code files.
scan_regex: Stub:\s*(describe module\/script purpose here\.|list known issues here\.|list pending work here\.)
remediation: Replace placeholders with concrete content or remove the block entirely in production scripts/modules.
examples:
# Bad
<# Outline:
    Stub: describe module/script purpose here.
#>

# Good
<# Outline:
    Maintains pipeline artifact integrity checks.
#>
